name: motivs
description: Build and validate spreadsheet automations without sending source rows or cell values to the AI tool.

interface.longDescription: Motivs turns rough instructions and recurring Excel or CSV work into validated reports, plans, and decision-ready outputs. It uses only the analysis the outcome requires while protected examples stay inside Motivs for isolated testing.
defaultPrompt: Build the Motivs automation named Monthly sales report.
Find my draft automation and define its workflow.

publication.release_notes: Improved collaborative-workspace permission guidance, immutable version lineage and pinned-run handling, privacy-safe diagnostics, and protected Excel/CSV workflow validation.
